room_rent.note: Proportionate deduction on associated medical expenses if higher room chosen; not applied on pharmacy, consumables, implants, diagnostics, ICU charges

icu.note: ICU charges covered at actuals as part of inpatient benefit; no separate per-day cap stated for ICU room

copayment.note: Mandatory 10% co-payment applies to every admissible claim amount for all insured persons

sub_limits.display: Cataract, bariatric, modern treatments, rehab, home care, newborn, OPD capped
sub_limits.note: Cataract: ₹25k/₹35k; Bariatric: ₹90k/₹1.5L; Modern treatments: various sub-limits (30% SI for some); Rehab & Pain Mgmt: ₹25k; Home Care: 10% SI; Newborn: 10% SI; OPD: ₹2k/₹3k; Ambulance: ₹1,500/hosp

initial_waiting.note: Not applicable for accidents; waived if continuously covered for more than 12 months

ped_waiting.note: 36 months continuous coverage; reducible via portability credits from prior insurer

specific_disease_waiting.note: Covers cataract, ENT, thyroid, hernia, joint replacement, gallbladder, kidney stones, gynaec conditions, varicose veins, and many others; not applicable for accidents

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Code Excl 18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of SI added per claim-free year up to 50% max; reduced at same rate on a claim; mutually exclusive with No Claim Discount — insured must choose one at first purchase

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording

day_care.note: All day care procedures covered up to sum insured

domiciliary.note: Covered up to SI for treatment >3 days; excludes asthma, bronchitis, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, psychiatric disorders, arthritis, gout and several other conditions

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH at recognised AYUSH hospitals covered up to SI; Yoga & Naturopathy requires prior approval

organ_donor.note: Includes harvesting of donated organ; 36-month waiting period applies

ambulance.note: Road ambulance: ₹1,500 per hospitalisation, ₹3,000 per policy year; covers transport to hospital, hospital-to-hospital, and hospital-to-home (same city with doctor certificate)

modern_treatments.note: Robotic surgery for knee/hip replacement capped at ₹4L or SI; some procedures up to SI; others at 30% SI (cyto-reduction, intravitreal injections, oral chemo, etc.)

consumables.note: Consumables listed in List I are excluded; Lists II–IV items subsumed into room/procedure charges but not separately payable

global_cover.note: Territorial limit: all treatments must be taken in India (Condition 23)

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud; applies to original SI; enhanced SI has fresh 60-month period on enhanced portion

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes; coverage not available during grace period except for instalment payers

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration

portability.note: IRDAI-compliant portability; apply at least 30 days before but not earlier than 60 days from renewal date

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, dental (non-accidental), venereal diseases, erectile dysfunction, vaccination, EECP/chelation/hyperbaric O2, PRP/platelet-rich plasma, biologicals (outpatient)

optional_riders.display: No Claim Discount (in lieu of Cumulative Bonus) — must choose at inception; no other riders mentioned
